theme.title: From Tip to Buzzer
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Michael Jordan scored 55 in Game 4 of the 1993 Finals. How many did LeBron James score in his 2018 Game 1 loss at Golden State?
questions.context: 2018 NBA Finals · Game 1 · at Golden State

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James scored 51 points in Game 1, the fifth-highest point total for an NBA Finals game and the most in a loss

funFacts.text: J. R. Smith grabbed an offensive rebound with the game tied but ran toward midcourt instead of shooting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: dribbled the ball towards half court rather than taking a final shot

funFacts.text: LeBron played the remainder of the Finals with a bruised hand after punching a whiteboard in frustration.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: suffering a bone contusion in his hand that he kept private for the rest of the series

funFacts.text: Klay Thompson returned to the opener after hurting his leg in the first quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: suffered a leg injury in the first quarter, but returned in the second quarter

questions.prompt: The 2013–14 Spurs opened the season with an NBA-record number of international players. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They also entered the season with an NBA-record ten international players.

funFacts.text: French forward Boris Diaw became a key ball-mover on the championship roster.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Diaw led all players in the series in assists

funFacts.text: The team's system spread minutes so widely that no Spur averaged half an hour during the regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: The Finals marked the return of a less punishing travel format, partly enabled by charter flights.

source.quote: as well as the increased use of chartered flights as opposed to commercial flights

questions.prompt: How many three-pointers did Dan Majerle make during the Suns' 1992–93 season?
questions.note: 167 made threes, tying for the league lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finished tied in first place in the league with 167 three-point field goals

funFacts.text: Majerle averaged 16.9 points and 1.7 steals a game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dan Majerle averaged 16.9 points and 1.7 steals per game

funFacts.text: He was named to the NBA's All-Defensive Second Team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: was named to the NBA All-Defensive Second Team

funFacts.text: Reserve guard Danny Ainge also made 150 threes during the same season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ainge contributed 11.8 points per game and 150 three-point field goals, also off the bench

questions.prompt: The chart shows deficits teams came back from. How many points did Golden State trail by at halftime of Game 1 of the 1975 Finals?
questions.context: Washington Bullets vs Golden State · Game 1
questions.note: 14 points, before Golden State's second-half comeback.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bullets built a 14-point lead at the half over the Warriors

funFacts.text: Warriors reserve Phil Smith provided an unexpected scoring boost off the bench during the comeback.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Phil Smith coming off the bench to score 20 points in 31 minutes

funFacts.text: The opening game took place at the Capital Centre in Landover, Maryland, outside Washington.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Capital Centre, Landover, Maryland

funFacts.text: Golden State reached the Finals after defeating the Chicago Bulls in a seven-game Western final.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: then eliminated Thurmond and the Bulls in seven games to advance to the Finals

questions.prompt: Facing elimination at Milwaukee in 2022, Jayson Tatum forced a Game 7. How many points did he score?
questions.context: Benchmark: Jimmy Butler scored 56 against Milwaukee in 2023
questions.note: 46 points, plus nine boards, to force Game 7 and keep Boston alive.

source.quote: Jayson Tatum led the way with 46 points, nine rebounds and four assists

funFacts.text: Boston forced a seventh game in its home arena.
